description: This header file declares functions related to parsing URLs within the lighttpd web server project, specifically functions for parsing raw URLs, paths, and hostnames into a request URI structure.

methods.name: li_parse_raw_url
methods.description: Parses the raw URL string into its components within a request URI structure. The URI object must be initialized prior to calling this function.

methods.name: li_parse_raw_path
methods.description: Parses an input string into the path, raw path, and query components of the URI, decoding and simplifying the path if parsing succeeds.

methods.name: li_parse_hostname
methods.description: Extracts and parses the hostname from the URI object.
